text.en:
Section 1 of the Presidential Decree No. 1609 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Any provision of law, executive or administrative order, rule or regulation, to the contrary notwithstanding
the importation free from customs duties and other importation taxes and charges of liquefied petroleum gas,
motor gasoline, naphtha, and liquefied natural gas liquids by persons or entities duly authorized by the Bureau
of Energy Utilization, shall be allowed for the duration of the present supply emergency or until the domestic
prices of refined petroleum products shall have been adjusted. Similar importation free from customs duties
and other importation taxes and charges for other petroleum products, the supply of which may become
critical during the period of emergency, shall similarly be allowed when directed by the President of the
Philippines upon recommendation of the Minister of Energy."

This Decree shall effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila this 28th day of February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-nine.
